description: Live CTF at DEF CON 30 features head-to-head, real-time binary exploitation and reverse engineering battles between top competitive hacker teams with live commentary.

talks.title: LiveCTF: Day 1 (Part 1)
talks.teaser: Live match commentary and real-time binary exploitation battles from Day 1 (Part 1) of the DEF CON 30 LiveCTF competition.
talks.summary:
In this live esports-style broadcast from DEF CON 30, commentators cover the opening matches of the annual LiveCTF tournament, featuring fast-paced, head-to-head 1v1 binary exploitation matches between world-class hackers. At 47:00, the commentators analyze real-time gameplay as competitors reverse engineer unfamiliar binary binaries, hunt for memory corruption vulnerabilities, and navigate subtle mmap memory management quirks under strict time limits.

The broadcast explores challenge design at 01:46:00, with commentary on why certain custom binary problems forced competitors to rethink standard stack-smashing assumptions. At 02:42:00, the hosts profile standout collegiate CTF teams, spotlighting Oregon State University's strong performance and rising prominence across competitive hacking circuits.

As matches progress into the later stages at 03:38:00, the stream highlights the intense pressure of speedrun exploitation as competitors race against the 45-minute countdown clock. The segment concludes at 04:22:00 with walkthroughs of winning exploit chains and a recap of scoreboard standings as Day 1 Part 1 draws to a close. (AI summary — Gemini Flash)
